questions.:question/problem:
Find the product $AB$, if
$$
\displaystyle A=\begin{bmatrix}2\sqrt{7} & -3 & 3.5 \\ -2 & 2\sqrt{5} & -2.5 \\ \sqrt{3} & 4 & 5\end{bmatrix}
$$
and 
$$
\displaystyle B=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{bmatrix}.
$$
questions.:question/worked-solution:
Notice that $B$ is the $1$st *column* of the identity matrix ${I}_{3}.$

Since we're multiplying the $3\times 3$ matrix $A$ by the $1$st *column* of the identity matrix ${I}_{3},$ the result must be the $1$st *column* of $A.$ Therefore,

$$
AB=\begin{bmatrix}2\sqrt{7} \\ -2 \\ \sqrt{3}\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Let's check the long way:

$$
\begin{aligned}AB & =\begin{bmatrix}2\sqrt{7} & -3 & 3.5 \\ -2 & 2\sqrt{5} & -2.5 \\ \sqrt{3} & 4 & 5\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}2\sqrt{7}\cdot 1+(-3)\cdot 0+3.5\cdot 0 \\ (-2)\cdot 1+2\sqrt{5}\cdot 0+(-2.5)\cdot 0 \\ \sqrt{3}\cdot 1+4\cdot 0+5\cdot 0\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}2\sqrt{7} \\ -2 \\ \sqrt{3}\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

questions.:question/problem:

$$
and 
$$
\displaystyle B=\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{bmatrix}.
$$
questions.:question/worked-solution:
Notice that $B$ is the $2$nd *column* of the identity matrix ${I}_{3}.$

Since we're multiplying the $3\times 3$ matrix $A$ by the $2$nd *column* of the identity matrix ${I}_{3},$ the result must be the $2$nd *column* of $A.$ Therefore,

$$
AB=\begin{bmatrix}-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \\ \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \\ 0\end{bmatrix}.
$$

Let's check the long way:

$$
\begin{aligned}AB & =\begin{bmatrix}\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} & -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} & 0 \\ \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} & \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cdot 0+\left(\frac{-\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)\cdot 1+0\cdot 0 \\ \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cdot 0+\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cdot 1+0\cdot 0 \\ 0\cdot 0+0\cdot 1+1\cdot 0\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \\ \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \\ 0\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\displaystyle A=\begin{bmatrix}2 & \sqrt{2} & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & -4 \\ 5\sqrt{3} & \sqrt{3} & -2\sqrt{7}\end{bmatrix}

$$

$$
